metadata.title: TDLAS startup and login visual system

limitations: Raster pixels do not establish Qt logical pixels, client area, DPR, OS scaling or breakpoint behavior.
Only the visible startup brand state and login idle state are evidenced.
Authentication, roles, persistence, loading progress and navigation are not evidenced by the images.

screenInventory.summary: Centered translucent brand card with logo, product title, descriptor, attribution and spectroscopy illustration.
Desktop split composition with scientific illustration on the left and brand plus credentials form on the right.

primitives.rule: Preserve the source aspect ratio and center the image; letterbox rather than stretch.
Approximately 62 percent illustration and 38 percent authentication area within the rounded card.
Username field, password field and primary button form one vertical semantic stack.

fixedCompositionException.rule: Normalized reference coordinates may align raster artwork and live controls, but controls inside each region must use Qt layouts.

components.responsibility: Scale and center the approved raster without distortion.
Collect the account identifier with a persistent accessible name.
Collect a masked password without storing it.
Submit user intent exactly once to the host authentication layer.

color.name: canvas.coolBlue
color.note: Representative raster sample, not a source design token.

color.name: surface.login
color.note: Candidate opaque field surface used to cover baked raster controls.

typography.name: font.ui
typography.note: Implementation fallback only; exact source font is UNKNOWN.

desktop.rule: Keep the source aspect ratio and map live controls through the fitted image rectangle.

minimumClientSize.note: Reversible template candidate, not established by the images.

mobileOrReflow.note: No mobile or narrow-window reference was supplied.

implementationGuidance: Use real QLineEdit and QPushButton controls for the login form.
Keep credential storage, authentication, roles and navigation outside the UI class.
Do not infer progress or a startup duration from S-01.
Use the original raster only as approved visual evidence and verify its packaging rights before release.
Calibrate the temporary normalized overlay coordinates after target client size, DPR, font and window chrome are confirmed.

inconsistencies.description: S-01 uses a transparent 2:1 canvas while S-02 uses an opaque approximately 16:9 canvas.
inconsistencies.handling: Treat them as two screen-specific aspect ratios, not one global viewport token.

confidenceSummary.EXACT: File identity, pixel dimensions, alpha presence and hashes.
confidenceSummary.INFERRED: Semantic components, aspect-ratio preservation, desktop form stack and implementation mapping.
confidenceSummary.ESTIMATED: Region geometry, raster-derived colors, spacing and radii.
confidenceSummary.UNKNOWN: Target logical size, DPR, exact fonts, animation, authentication, roles, errors and navigation.
